(''13 August 2014'') |average attendance = 6,499 |prevseason = [[2013–14 South African Premier Division|2013–14]] |nextseason = [[2015–16 South African Premiership|2015–16]] |updated = 24 April 2015 }} The '''2014–15 South African Premiership''' season (known as the '''ABSA Premiership''' for sponsorship reasons) was the nineteenth season of the [[South African Premiership|Premiership]] since its establishment in 1996. Fixtures were announced 5 June 2014.{{cite web|title=Opening PSL 2014/15 matches|url=http://www.sport24.co.za/Soccer/PSL/Opening-PSL-201415-matches-20140605 |publisher=Sport24|access-date=5 June 2014}} The league opened on 8 August 2014 and will conclude on 9 May 2015. [[Mamelodi Sundowns F.C.|Mamelodi Sundowns]] were the defending champions, having won the previous [[2013–14 South African Premier Division]] season. [[Chippa United F.C.|Chippa United]] earned their second promotion to the top-tier league after winning the [[2013–14 National First Division|2013-14 National First Division]]. [[Polokwane City F.C.|Polokwane City]] remained in the league after beating [[Black Leopards F.C.|Black Leopards]] and [[Milano United F.C.|Milano United]] in the [[2013–14 National First Division#PSL Playoff Tournament|Playoff Tournament]]. ==Teams== ===Stadiums and locations=== {{location map+ |South Africa |float=right |width=470 |caption=Location of teams in the '''2014–15 Premiership'''. |places= {{location map~ |South Africa |mark=City locator 15.svg |lat=-33.903461 |long=18.411153 |label='''[[Ajax Cape Town F.C.|Ajax]]''' |position=left}} {{location map~ |South Africa |mark=City locator 15.svg |lat=-29.829444 |long=31.030278 |label='''[[AmaZulu F.C.
